title: Greedy Panda
paragraphs: I silently prepared to start rowing with the oar. Father seemed to have cast an aura in response to Sakura-chan’s request.
“Well then, I’ll start rowing.”
“Ah, okay. I’ll help too.”
I synchronized my movements with Father as we rowed the small boat together. Of course, both of us had enough strength, so the boat gained tremendous speed.
“Whoa! It’s rocking! It’s rocking!”
Panda and her followers were desperately clinging to the edge to avoid falling off.
“Oh my, this is so easy.”
Older Sister leapt flamboyantly out of the sea, did a full rotation in the air, and returned to the water. That reminded me of a jump from a dolphin show at an aquarium.
“Whoa…”
Father seemed mesmerized by what Older Sister had just done. His eyes were sparkling.
“Is it about time? Naofumi-chan, stop.”
“Uh, yeah. Got it.”

Following Older Sister’s instructions, we stopped rowing. I casually turned my gaze toward the surface of the sea. It’s beautiful. The water is incredibly clear. However… it seems to be a reef-filled area. Of course, there’s also an island nearby.
“If we swim a little, we can reach the island, but for today, we’ll have a combination of swimming, hunting monsters, and salvaging here.”
“I heard about that, but is it really okay?”

Just then, a monster called a Blue Shark, which resembled a shark, charged at Older Sister. But Older Sister swiftly slapped the Blue Shark’s face with her tail and then quickly skewered it with a harpoon.
“It’s fine. In these shallow waters, no serious monsters appear. Even Sasa-chan can handle them.”
“Don’t underestimate me and think I’m weak!”
Panda shouted angrily at Older Sister. Well, yes. On land, she could probably hold her own.
“Now, now, we’re all here, so it’ll be fine, right?”
“Indeed. With us here, any monster is just a weakling.”
“Hmph. Let’s see how long that confidence lasts.”
Despite her words, Panda didn’t sound intimidating in the slightest. If that’s what you think, just watch and see. I’ll show you the difference in our abilities!
“Shall we go now?”
“Yeah. Everyone, don’t panic when the monsters come. Fight them carefully and steadily. With this formation, we won’t lose. If anything happens, you can rely on Sadeena-san, me, or Motoyasu-kun.”

And so, we dove into the sea. By the way, the swimsuits that Assistant and Mole were wearing were equipped with enhancements that made it easier to move underwater. Yuki-chan and Sakura-chan could swim just fine. They had learned how to swim back on Cal Mira Island.
“Ah, I found a monster!”
It seems that the smell of blood from the Blue Shark that Older Sister defeated has attracted other monsters.
“Alright, I’ll go first then.”

With that, Older Sister swiftly swam through the water and speared the monsters. Even though her stats are overwhelmingly high, underwater combat puts her ahead of me. Should I use a skill to shoot them down?
“Here we go!”

Panda, along with her beastman subordinates, struck the water’s surface with an oar to lure out piranha-like monsters that attack from below and sliced them apart with her claws. Is she not going into the water?
“Larsa-san, aren’t you going into the water?”
“Think about what’s best! Leave the sea to her…”
“Sasa-chan, there’s a sunken ship at the bottom of the sea, you know? There might be tons of treasure down there.”
Panda threw aside the oar and dove into the sea. What a greedy panda.
“Where’s the treasure?!”
“That was fast! Her eyes turned to gold!? Larsa-san is so money-minded.”
“Shut up! Hurry up and dive!”
“Gaelion and the others are defeating the monsters!”
Rival transformed into his dragon form… and swam with impressive skill. He was swimming awkwardly, twisting his body in a weird, wavy motion, while carrying Assistant and Mole.
“Fighting here is completely different from fighting on land… but swimming is fun too!”
“Y-Yes. It feels like digging through the ground, and I can move forward, but… I can’t seem to land any attacks on the monsters…”
“The resistance is strong. You should focus on thrusting attacks, but using a short sword is tough. And since your magic is earth-based…”
Father seemed to be pondering Mole’s concerns. At that moment, Older Sister came up beside Father and patted his shoulder.
“That’s why I prepared something for you guys.”
Older Sister climbed onto the boat, opened a long box she had brought, and handed harpoons to Mole, Assistant, Panda, and her subordinates.
“They’re cheap, but use these to fight.”
There was something that looked like rubber attached to the bottom of the harpoon. Ah, I remember this.
“Pull the rubber at the back, aim carefully, and loosen your grip. That way, the harpoon will shoot out with force and hit the target.”
Older Sister was giving a lecture like that. I’ve used a harpoon as a weapon before, so I know how to use it.
“Now then! It’s hunting time! Come on, Yuki-chan! Let’s get some exercise!”
“I’ll do my best!”
I swam alongside Yuki-chan and charged at the monsters. It’s probably being done to give Panda, her subordinates, Assistant, and Mole some combat experience. So, I refrained from using any skills.

It’s such a hassle that sometimes I have to hold back to gain trust and strength that can’t be obtained by just leveling up. I was thinking of going after stronger monsters, but I don’t know much about the sea. Of course, I know from game knowledge that there are underwater fields and dungeons, but that’s not here.

I speared the monsters together with Yuki-chan, finished them off, and tossed them onto the small boat at the surface. Doesn’t this mean we can expect a luxurious meal tonight? I feel like we’re getting farther and farther away from Father and the others.
“Motoyasu-kun—”

Since we’re underwater, the voice didn’t carry well, but we can get back quickly, so it’s not a problem. If we get too far away, it’ll be hard to bring the monster materials as souvenirs because we’re underwater. So, I absorbed them into the spear. With that, I kept swimming and defeating monsters until Yuki-chan was satisfied. We can’t go too deep since we’d run out of breath.
“Shall we head back soon?”
“Yes. I believe we’ve swum the distance the breeder mentioned.”

It was also part of Yuki-chan’s training. This should be enough. But I still feel a bit unsatisfied. My magic doesn’t work well underwater, so I can’t cast spells. Just then, Father and Older Sister swam gracefully towards me and Yuki-chan. Even Sakura-chan and Rival were with them.
Assistant and Mole aren’t here? What’s going on? Father, with his hand on Older Sister’s dorsal fin, looks quite impressive.
“Motoyasu-kun, how’s it going? You suddenly went off somewhere, and I was surprised.”
“Everything’s going smoothly. I believe Yuki-chan has more than met her training quota.”
“Wow, that’s amazing.”
“I see, I see. We’ve had quite a good haul too. Sadeena-san, were you aiming for monster swarms… or rather, schools of fish?”
“Of course. It looks like we’ve done enough hunting, so maybe we should unload everything at the port later?”
“Yeah. Selling fresh fish should bring in some money.”
“By the way, didn’t Panda go salvaging?”
“Yeah. She found a little treasure… should I call it buried treasure?”
Saying that, Father showed me something that looked like a rainbow-colored coin. I don’t know its value, but it looks like something quite valuable.
“According to Larsa, it’s a type of currency that was in limited circulation one or two generations ago. Apparently, collectors will pay a high price for it.”
“I thought it was gold.”
“I thought so too. But free diving has its limits. Wyndia-chan and Imiya-chan are waiting with Larsa and the others.”
Even with underwater gear and skills, there are still areas we haven’t fully mastered. I’m still halfway there myself.
